name: duggal-badmosh-daily
description: Duggal Badmosh Daily Newspaper - community-submitted, AI-rewritten, deeply unserious news.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix apps/api run format && npm --prefix apps/web run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix apps/api run format:check && npm --prefix apps/web run format:check
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
